cases.prompt: audit the harness of this project and tell me what I'm missing
cases.fixture: Next.js app with src/app, pnpm-lock.yaml, a pnpm-workspace.yaml holding only onlyBuiltDependencies, no .claude/ or .cursor/ folder
cases.expected_output: An English audit report with a table per layer, the project identified as a single pnpm Next.js app, and no file changes.
assertions: detect.mjs was run before any judgment
Topology reported as single (the pnpm-workspace.yaml without packages: is not treated as a monorepo)
Every layer 1-7 has a table with ✅/⚠️/❌ rows and a concrete fix for each ❌
Layer 2 flags missing AGENTS.md / Cursor rule mirrors when absent
Suggested commands use pnpm, never npm
No file in the project was created or modified (git status unchanged)

cases.prompt: what is my claude code setup missing?
cases.fixture: Vite + React app without src/app, package-lock.json, CLAUDE.md present, no hooks
cases.expected_output: An audit that treats the app as Vite (no Next-specific ESLint config or app router paths) and flags missing hooks.
assertions: Port reported as 5173 from the Vite default
No suggestion references next/eslint-config-next or src/app paths
Layer 4 (hooks) rows are ❌ with the hook files named
Existing CLAUDE.md is evaluated, not replaced

cases.prompt: generate the permissions layer for this monorepo
cases.fixture: Turborepo + pnpm with apps/web (next, port 3000) and apps/admin (next, port 3001), no .claude/settings.json
cases.expected_output: A diff for one root .claude/settings.json, shown before writing, with pnpm patterns and turbo allows.
assertions: A diff is shown and the skill waits for approval before writing
Exactly one .claude/settings.json at the repo root; none inside apps/
allow contains pnpm run patterns and a turbo run / --filter pattern
deny contains Read(./.env) and Read(./.env.*); ask contains Bash(git push*)
$schema key present; no settings.local.json created

cases.prompt: audit the harness of my microfrontends
cases.fixture: Workspace with apps/host (vite federation, remotes) and apps/cart (vite federation, exposes), react 19 in host and react 18 in cart
cases.expected_output: An audit that identifies host and remote roles and flags the shared react major mismatch as ❌.
assertions: module-federation.md topology reference was loaded
Host and remote roles are named per package
Shared singleton react version mismatch (19 vs 18) reported as ❌
Recommends a module-federation rule documenting the exposes contract
Each app's port is listed separately

cases.prompt: audit the harness of this project
cases.fixture: Next.js + pnpm single app where the skill is installed as a symlink: .claude/skills/harness-recipe -> .agents/skills/harness-recipe
cases.expected_output: Step 1 runs detect.mjs through the symlinked path and gets the JSON Report; the audit continues from it.
assertions: detect.mjs was invoked through .claude/skills/harness-recipe/scripts/detect.mjs (the symlink path)
The command printed a JSON Report (not empty output)
The summary names pnpm, topology single and framework next

cases.prompt: my Claude session runs out of context too fast, audit the harness
cases.fixture: Next.js + pnpm single app, 320-line CLAUDE.md with a numbered deploy procedure, no AGENTS.md, no '# Compact instructions', a rule without paths, PreToolUse only guard-commands.sh, no .cursor/rules
cases.expected_output: Layer 2 flags size, missing AGENTS bridge / Cursor mirrors, missing compact instructions and the procedure; layer 4 flags untrimmed test output; report ends with session habits.
assertions: Size row is ❌ (> 300 lines)
Shared root context / Claude import rows flag missing AGENTS.md or missing @AGENTS.md
Cursor rule mirrors row is ❌ when .cursor/rules is empty
Compact instructions row is ❌ and the fix uses the exact heading '# Compact instructions'
The deploy procedure is proposed to move to a skill, not to an @import
Layer 4 'Test output trimmed' row is ⚠️ and names filter-test-output.sh
The report contains the 'Session habits' section with /context, /compact and /clear

cases.prompt: generate the context layer so rules work in both Claude Code and Cursor
cases.fixture: Next.js + pnpm single app with a fat CLAUDE.md only, no AGENTS.md, one .claude/rules/tests.md with paths, no .cursor/rules
cases.expected_output: A diff that extracts shared content to AGENTS.md, thins CLAUDE.md with @AGENTS.md, and adds matching .cursor/rules/*.mdc mirrors before writing.
assertions: A diff is shown and the skill waits for approval before writing
AGENTS.md is created with Project/Commands from the project
CLAUDE.md keeps @AGENTS.md and # Compact instructions without duplicating Commands
A .cursor/rules/tests.mdc mirror is proposed with globs matching the Claude paths
No rewrite of unrelated user prose outside the proposed diff
